goal: Build a proper phone app with PWA install button, zero horizontal scroll, pinch-to-zoom editing, instant desktop auto-sync for files created on phone, and QR auth verification

stories.title: PWA Engine, Manifest & Web Browser Install Button
stories.description: Configure manifest.json and create PWAInstallPrompt with beforeinstallprompt handling, Chrome/Android install button, and iOS Safari Add to Home Screen instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json configured with standalone display, correct orientation, and PQS branding
PWAInstallPrompt component detects beforeinstallprompt and renders interactive Install button
iOS Safari users receive clear Add to Home Screen instructions sheet
Prompts hide when app is already installed in standalone mode
layout.tsx metadata includes viewport, apple-touch-icon, and theme-color

stories.title: Mobile UX Polish & Zero Horizontal Scroll
stories.description: Eliminate all horizontal scroll across the application on phones, provide responsive card list view for Recent Files on mobile, and ensure form touch targets are 44px+.
acceptanceCriteria: globals.css enforces overflow-x hidden on root viewport
Home page renders responsive mobile card view for Recent Files on screens < 768px
Desktop displays full structured 7-column table on md: and above
Form input font size is at least 16px to prevent iOS auto-zoom
All buttons and tap targets meet WCAG 44x44px mobile touch standards

stories.title: Fit-to-Screen & Touch Pinch-to-Zoom Document Viewport
stories.description: Create responsive fit-to-screen scaling and touch pinch-to-zoom for A4 document previews across pas-report, invoice, editor, and letterhead pages.
acceptanceCriteria: A4 preview pages auto-fit to screen width on mobile (fitScale ≈ 0.45 on 390px screens) with zero horizontal overflow
Two-finger pinch gesture smoothly zooms preview in and out
Floating mobile zoom bar provides Fit, Zoom In, Zoom Out, and 100% buttons
Double-tap resets zoom to screen-width fit
Applied to pas-report, invoice, editor, and letterhead pages

stories.title: Instant Desktop Auto-Cloud Sync Engine
stories.description: Implement automated background sync in PC desktop app that immediately checks Supabase on launch for any files created or edited from mobile, and saves them to the decided Desktop backup folder.
acceptanceCriteria: cloudSyncEngine runs automatically on PC launch in Tauri desktop app
Compares cloud receipts in Supabase against local backup ledger and files
Automatically generates and saves PDFs in year/month/date/report folder structure on Desktop
Displays desktop toast notification showing count of synced mobile files
Listens to window focus to re-sync if new files were created while PC was running

stories.title: QR Code & Auth Verification on Mobile
stories.description: Ensure QR code verification portal loads smoothly on mobile, supports auto-authentication when auth token is present, and provides touch-friendly PIN unlock.
acceptanceCriteria: PASHeader QR code encodes verification URL with seal and optional auth token
Verify page (/verify/receipt) automatically verifies and loads when auth token is present
Touch-friendly PIN entry form for manual report verification on phones
Verified report preview scales to mobile screen width with zero horizontal scroll
Invoices and letterheads verify immediately without password barriers

stories.title: Web Quality Audit, Production Build & Quality Gate
stories.description: Perform 38-point web quality audit, bump version to 6.7.0, verify production build, and push to main.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build completes with exit code 0 and all 11 static pages generated
TypeScript passes with zero type errors
All 38 anti-vibecoding defects addressed
Git commit and push completed successfully
